question: Should xAI Platform prepaid credits be implemented as a first-party `xai` provider now, deferred until sanitized response proof is supplied, or handled later through the accepted custom-provider path?
rationale: The official xAI endpoint documentation changes the earlier contract audit, but choosing a new first-party provider versus the custom-provider roadmap is a product/auth boundary decision and the issue still lacks real response proof.

options.title: Defer until response proof
options.body: Keep this open and ask for a sanitized Management API prepaid-balance and usage response before any implementation PR.

options.title: Sponsor first-party xAI provider
options.body: Approve a separate `xai` provider using explicit Management API credentials, team ID configuration, focused parser tests, and no Grok fallback.

options.title: Route through custom provider work
options.body: Wait for the accepted custom-provider identity, evaluator, transport, approval, and proof slices, then document an xAI configuration recipe.

recommendation.title: Defer until response proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open and ask for a sanitized Management API prepaid-balance and usage response before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the issue's contract audit and the accepted custom-provider design boundary, making him the clearest owner for the provider/auth direction.
